note: Capability & data-source taxonomy for the corpus capability lens (Phase 29). codes (C*/D*) match each derived indicator. posture is the institution self-assessment from the Phase-28 interview (y=in place · partial · n=not yet) — grounded, illustrative; the always-on badge applies. Validated at the build boundary (build.py validate_capability_taxonomy): closed vocab + referential integrity against the 42 derived records.

capabilities.name: Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring
capabilities.desc: Baseline each customer's expected activity (volume, value, instrument mix, counterparties) and alert on out-of-profile deviation, sudden onset on a previously-unrelated account, dormant-account reactivation, and post-closure migration of payment identifiers to unrelated parties.

capabilities.name: Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection
capabilities.desc: Detect funds-in then rapid funds-out with low residual balance — deposit→drain, reimbursement→pass-through, EMT/wire/CVC in-and-out velocity, conduit accounts that are not an economic endpoint; the core mule/layering signature.

capabilities.name: Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection
capabilities.desc: Identify many-to-one aggregation (multiple unrelated originators, addresses or jurisdictions converging on one beneficiary off the holder's geography/profile) and the inverse one-to-many disbursement to unrelated payees.

capabilities.name: Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion
capabilities.desc: Detect deposits/transactions kept below CTR/CMIR/aggregation thresholds, same-day multi-location structured cash, small-to-large denomination exchange, transactions cancelled when a report is triggered, and DD-avoidance account closures.

capabilities.name: Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Profile expected cash behaviour and flag oversized, off-hours or peer-divergent cash activity — cash inconsistent with the business line, cash-funded cashier's cheques/drafts and OTC bills, bulk-cash vault/armored-car deposits, and large card cash advances.

capabilities.name: Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring
capabilities.desc: Behavioural baselining that fires on high-velocity throughput unrelated to expected activity, volume far above the account's own history or its profession peers, multiple no-rationale accounts, and dormant accounts reactivating into outflows.

capabilities.name: Peer / business-activity anomaly (revenue-vs-operations) detection
capabilities.desc: Reconcile inflows against stated size, headcount and line of business and against same-segment peers, and against expected operating outflows (payroll, opex, copayments); fires when reimbursements/benefits/ERC exceed peer baseline or have no matching opex.

capabilities.name: Income / occupation-vs-activity profile-inconsistency detection
capabilities.desc: Compare inflows, spend and asset acquisition against KYC-declared occupation, income and expected scale — unexplained wealth, low-income-vs-wealth, business income not commensurate, and declared-industry-vs-procurement mismatch (e.g. non-chemical buyer purchasing precursors).

capabilities.name: Merchant-category (MCC) / spend-pattern screening
capabilities.desc: Score card/POS spend by merchant category for typology-indicative baskets — bulk gift-card/prepaid retail, escort-advertising, lodging clustering, lab/pill-press/heavy-machinery, capture-gear, hydroponics/grow-supply, wildlife/traditional-medicine merchants, luxury/auto/real-estate with no business nexus.

capabilities.name: Transaction-narrative / memo-line keyword screening
capabilities.desc: Keyword and pattern screening over payment memos, EMT/P2P notes and reference fields — drug street-names, escort names, wildlife species, CSE/sextortion phrases, micro-value advertising memos, terrorism/charity language, and no-purpose / round-dollar narratives.

capabilities.name: Counterfeit / altered negotiable-instrument & check-fraud screening
capabilities.desc: Examine deposited or cashed checks/drafts for altered amounts, inconsistent stock, counterfeit Treasury/government checks, mail-theft markers and unverifiable items — supports check-fraud, ERC-check and check-cashing indicators.

capabilities.name: Identity-verification, synthetic-identity & deepfake detection
capabilities.desc: At onboarding/re-verification detect document tampering, cross-document mismatch, GenAI/deepfake photos and text, MFA refusal, channel-switching, and geo/device-vs-document mismatch — the impersonation and synthetic-identity surface.

capabilities.name: Account-opening / KYC risk profiling
capabilities.desc: Risk-score new and thin-history accounts at opening — non-resident or inexperienced owners, single-purpose accounts (ERC-only, benefit-only, deposit-only), and beneficial owners with prior fraud convictions.

capabilities.name: KYC integrity & customer-cooperation screening
capabilities.desc: Treat onboarding-data quality and responsiveness as a signal — incomplete/inaccurate KYC, refusal to disclose UBO, evasive answers about a blocked person, and non-response to KYC-refresh/RFI requests.

capabilities.name: Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis
capabilities.desc: Resolve UBO and link customers by shared owners, addresses, devices/IPs, TINs or counterparties — front/shell companies at residential/co-located addresses, shared-owner rings, beneficiary-swap-with-unchanged-name, slight-name-variant clusters, and nominee/proxy control hiding a blocked party.

capabilities.name: Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection
capabilities.desc: Detect funds moving through nominee channels — lawyer/notary trust-account closings, third-party-funded deposits, mirror settlement of unrelated parties' cards, and drafts/EMTs from low-footprint legal professionals.

capabilities.name: PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening
capabilities.desc: Identify PEPs, close associates and proxies and link asset/transaction activity to them — including ownership dilution or transfers that drop a sanctioned/PEP party below disclosure thresholds.

capabilities.name: Sanctions / watchlist screening
capabilities.desc: Screen all parties and identifiers (name, address, email, phone, passport, IMO, crypto address) against OFAC/SDN, BIS Entity/debarred, Section 311 and FinCEN-registration/imposter references with fuzzy/near-match to catch identifier-nexus and name-variant hits.

capabilities.name: Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification
capabilities.desc: Enrich entities with negative news, prior convictions, extremist affiliation, and web-presence checks — minimal/PHE-timed online presence, residential/CMRA addresses, government-lookalike domains, and thin/absent footprint of shells and facilitators.

capabilities.name: Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Score wires/EFT against expected geography — no-nexus inbound foreign wires, bidirectional/round-trip CN-HK-UAE-LatAm corridors, conflict-zone/ISIS-prevalent/precursor-source jurisdictions, capital-control routing, and domestic-purpose funds routed cross-border.

capabilities.name: Virtual-currency / blockchain exposure & VASP screening
capabilities.desc: Screen CVC/stablecoin addresses and VASP counterparties against illicit-cluster attribution (darknet, CSAM, ransomware, mixer/tumbler, sanctions), trace chain-hopping into AECs, and flag first-time/off-profile/cash-funded conversions and kiosk transfers.

capabilities.name: Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Analyze trade documents, HS codes, consignee/end-user, routing and pricing — over/under-invoicing, transshipment-corridor routing, dual-use/EAR99 goods, freight-forwarder-as-end-customer, round-dollar goods payments, and deposits with no offsetting inventory purchasing.

capabilities.name: Vessel & maritime screening (AIS / IMO)
capabilities.desc: Reconcile shipping/payment parties against vessel and maritime databases to flag AIS gaps/manipulation, IMO spoofing, name/flag churn, false-flag use, ship-to-ship transfers, and shadow-fleet/sanctioned-vessel nexus.

capabilities.name: Trade / shipping & parcel-movement anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Detect physical-movement anomalies in the financial trail — sub-1kg/mislabeled parcels, bulk mailing-material buys, hazmat/waste-oil purchases without EPA registration, drop-shipping/PO-box/storage-locker use, and freight/postal/cargo payment frequency.

capabilities.name: Government-payment & reimbursement-integrity screening
capabilities.desc: Validate that government disbursements (EIP, ERC, Medicare/Medicaid/relief reimbursement, enrollee payments) reach a legitimate, enrolled, operating recipient — reconciling enrollment/eligibility, prior-year existence and concurrent-claim conflicts.

capabilities.name: Scam-typology / vulnerable-customer behavioral screening
capabilities.desc: Combine scam-marker memos (tech-support, winnings, taxes, fees, FinCEN-imposter), never-met/unknown counterparties, urgency/distress and vulnerable-customer attributes (senior, widowed, divorced) to flag elder-exploitation, romance and imposter scams from human-context signals.

capabilities.name: High-value-asset value, flipping & loan-structure anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Flag under-recorded purchase price with off-book balance, loans/mortgages above market value, successive flipping/buy-backs, over-market rushed bids, penalty-disregarding early payoffs, and unjustified collateral-light loan structures.

capabilities.name: Lifestyle / utility & sector-specific spend-anomaly detection
capabilities.desc: Detect spend signatures inconsistent with the stated business — excess packaging/shipping spend, utility/hydro anomalies (multiple/shared accounts, above-consumption, cross-province mismatch), and heavy electronics/luxury card spend.

data_sources.name: Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)
data_sources.desc: Booked deposits, withdrawals, ATM/cash, debit-card, P2P, NSF, cheques/drafts and internal transfers with balances and timestamps — the baseline feed for profiling, pass-through, structuring, velocity/dormancy and peer-anomaly logic.

data_sources.name: Cash & instrument channel data (ATM/ABM, teller, money orders, prepaid)
data_sources.desc: Teller and ATM/ABM (incl. white-label) cash detail, denominations, money-order and cashier's-cheque issuance, and reloadable-prepaid load/spend — feeds cash-intensity, structuring, bulk-cash and prepaid fan-out logic.

data_sources.name: Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)
data_sources.desc: Inbound/outbound wires, ACH, EMT/e-transfer, P2P and remittance/MSB flows with originator/beneficiary, amount, memo and jurisdiction — drives funnel-in, fan-out, corridor, no-purpose-payment and escalating-transfer logic.

data_sources.name: Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data
data_sources.desc: Debit/credit-card and POS streams with MCC codes, merchant names and acquirer/PSP identifiers — drives MCC/spend-pattern and escort/equipment/wildlife/luxury-merchant screening.

data_sources.name: Transaction narrative / free-text fields
data_sources.desc: Payment memos, EMT/P2P notes, email/reference and invoice-description fields — the surface for keyword/pattern screening of street-names, escort names, wildlife species, CSE/sextortion markers and round-dollar/no-purpose narratives.

data_sources.name: Check / negotiable-instrument image & metadata
data_sources.desc: Check images, MICR, stock, payee/issuer data plus reported mail-theft / never-received items — required for counterfeit, altered-instrument and Treasury/ERC-check screening.

data_sources.name: Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics
data_sources.desc: On-chain transaction graphs, address attribution/clustering (darknet, CSAM, ransomware, mixer/tumbler, OFAC-linked), VASP/kiosk identifiers and stablecoin mint/redemption — required for all CVC/VASP exposure screening and crypto pass-through tracing.

data_sources.name: KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data
data_sources.desc: Onboarding records — declared occupation/income/line-of-business and scale, account-open date, single-purpose flags, owner residency/experience, identity documents, registration status, UBO/TIN graph and KYC-refresh/RFI responses.

data_sources.name: Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry
data_sources.desc: ID-document images and cross-document checks, biometric/deepfake and GenAI-gallery results, MFA outcome, channel/webcam signals, and device/IP/geolocation/VPN telemetry — the impersonation, synthetic-identity and multi-country-access feed.

data_sources.name: Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data
data_sources.desc: Static customer/account attributes and linkage keys — phone numbers, addresses, shared identifiers, common-ownership graph and account-relationship maps — powering shared-identifier ring, common-owner and counterparty-network analytics.

data_sources.name: Sanctions / watchlist & regulator-action data
data_sources.desc: OFAC/SDN, BIS Entity/debarred, Section 311 designations, FinCEN registration/imposter references and state-regulator fraud flags, keyed by name and identifier (email/phone/passport/IMO/crypto-address) — the authority for party screening and near-match resolution.

data_sources.name: PEP & beneficial-ownership intelligence
data_sources.desc: PEP lists, close-associate and proxy linkage data, and corporate-ownership graphs — feeds PEP/sanctioned-elite proxy screening and entity-cluster resolution.

data_sources.name: Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence
data_sources.desc: Negative-news, conviction/litigation records, business-registration, web/social-presence, address-type (residential/CMRA) and domain-reputation data — for entity enrichment, government-impersonation and thin-footprint/shell detection.

data_sources.name: Government-program enrollment & eligibility data
data_sources.desc: Provider/enrollee enrollment and eligibility status, program identifiers, expected reimbursement profiles and prior-year-existence checks (Medicare/Medicaid, EIP, ERC, benefit programs) for reimbursement-integrity screening.

data_sources.name: Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data
data_sources.desc: Trade documents (invoices, bills of lading, LCs), HS codes, consignee/end-user and end-use detail, pricing references, freight-forwarder/parcel-weight/EPA-registration and routing/transshipment records — feeds documentary, transshipment and parcel-anomaly detection.

data_sources.name: Maritime / vessel data (AIS & registries)
data_sources.desc: AIS transponder tracks, IMO numbers, vessel name/flag/ownership-and-management registries and port-call history — feeds vessel/maritime screening for AIS gaps, spoofing, flag-hopping and shadow-fleet nexus.

data_sources.name: Geographic / jurisdiction risk reference
data_sources.desc: Jurisdiction and corridor risk ratings, high-risk-country lists (terror, CSE, wildlife-crime, precursor-source), border/migrant-corridor and tax-haven reference data — the lookup layer for corridor screening and travel-spend geo-coincidence.

data_sources.name: Real-estate / property & valuation data
data_sources.desc: Property registries, recorded purchase prices, market-valuation references, mortgage/loan terms and conveyancing/closing records — required for value, flipping, loan-above-value and rushed-close anomaly detection.

data_sources.name: Legal/notary trust-account & third-party-funding data
data_sources.desc: Visibility into solicitor/notary trust-account flows, deposit-cheque payer identity and third-party funding sources — for nominee-channel, anonymous-closing, deposit-cleansing round-trip and mirror-settlement detection.

data_sources.name: External / lifestyle reference data (utilities, registries, merchant classification)
data_sources.desc: Third-party feeds — utility/hydro consumption and billing, registered-vs-operating address, falsified-document/licence checks, and MCC/counterparty classification (luxury, auto, real estate, brokerage, betting, dating-platform processors) — for sector-specific spend and no-nexus-outflow flags.
